courseHelp.title: Course help
courseHelp.body:
Implement the named function above the supplied adapter. Run checks the example inputs. Submit checks all supplied cases. You can edit each sample input as a JSON object. The adapter passes its fields as named arguments and rejects input changes. Keep the adapter unchanged.

Python 3.11. Use the standard library.
